message: Imported canonical English Task 3 fixture Context 'guardrails/recipient-and-authority'.

5d8c0d9c-6e95-582c-9a5f-f3abc78ccebc.content: Verify the recipient's exact account or address before approval.

213bdf5e-d4d8-5133-930c-1bf97e83fe6a.content: For a system recipient rather than a person, display the service name as well.

b4abaae1-b2b4-5301-abb4-e08b5cbc304b.content: Do not infer sharing authority from the recipient's role alone.

a5a98da1-8d89-5117-9df9-7d37e67ea5a5.content: If there is a proxy recipient, separately confirm the actual delivery target.

e935f237-cd56-5bd2-ba4d-96ddd89ef2bd.content: Require new verification if the basis for the recipient's authority has expired.

cf2143d5-f1cc-5f6a-8799-718a0873b2cb.content: A recipient's identity and authority to receive are separate review items.

c0bdfe20-8e0b-5b69-b7d7-4ded37dc0a03.content: The local agent can compare presented recipient identifiers, but those identifiers alone cannot guarantee actual authority to receive.

23323a42-6d4e-5a8f-9aca-7b5a92ec4414.content: An intermediary service operator may regard transforming input before final delivery as permitted processing.
